clue.text: Governing body employs writer in the area

indicators.note: to employ is to take on or contain, so the area-word holds the writer-word within it

parts.note: a locality is an area or neighbourhood
an author is a writer

explanation.surface: A council takes on a local author to work in the district.
explanation.definitionFit: A council running a town or county is the governing body for its district.

clue.text: Put silk top in cupboard nearest to hand

indicators.note: in tells us the first letter of silk goes inside the cupboard-word

parts.note: a closet is a cupboard

indicators.note: the top of a word is its first letter in a down clue

explanation.surface: An instruction to put a silk top away in the wardrobe that is handiest.
explanation.definitionFit: Superlative of close, meaning near in distance.

clue.text: Left President Eisenhower to choose

parts.note: Ike was the nickname of US President Dwight Eisenhower

explanation.surface: Eisenhower was free to pick as he pleased.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Choose' works as in 'do as you choose', where the verb could be swapped for the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To wish or prefer, as in 'take whichever you please'.

clue.text: Fillet is reduced in price

explanation.surface: A butcher's fillet steak is marked down.
explanation.definitionFit: Undercut is the tenderloin of beef, taken from under the ribs; to undercut a rival is to sell more cheaply.

clue.text: Leave when the dance is cancelled

parts.note: a hop is an informal dance
an event that is off has been cancelled

explanation.surface: Someone decides to go home once the dance is called off.
explanation.definitionFit: A phrasal verb for getting down from a vehicle and departing.

clue.text: Whatever happens, don't stare so much

explanation.surface: Advice to someone gawping: carry on, but stop gazing.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is cryptic: to look at (regard) less is to stare less.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means come what may; split in two it says pay less attention.

clue.text: Complaint made by thickhead in Austen novel

indicators.note: in places the head letter inside the rearranged name
novel as an adjective means new, so the name is made new by rearranging it

parts.note: the head, or first letter, of thick is T

explanation.surface: A dim character in a Jane Austen book falls ill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like a book by Austen but signals an anagram: AUSTEN rearranged gives TEANUS, and 'in' puts T after its TE.
explanation.definitionFit: Lockjaw is a disease, and complaint means an illness.

clue.text: Influencing each other between stage performances

parts.note: inter- is the Latin prefix meaning between
acting is performing on stage

explanation.surface: Two things affect each other in the interval between plays.
explanation.definitionFit: To interact is to have a mutual effect, so the participle fits a reciprocal influence.

clue.text: Got better after being visited

explanation.surface: Someone improved once friends came round.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that looked up improved; you look up an old friend when you call on them.

clue.text: Manage to live in harmony

explanation.surface: An instruction to cope and coexist peacefully.
explanation.definitionFit: To get on is to cope or make progress, and also to have a friendly relationship.

clue.text: Redeeming virtue of the eponymous Miss Darling

explanation.surface: The one good point named after a heroine called Darling.
explanation.walkthrough: Grace Darling was a Victorian lighthouse keeper's daughter famed for rescuing shipwrecked sailors, so she was a Grace who saved lives.
explanation.definitionFit: A quality that makes up for faults; also a pun on Grace Darling's famous rescue.

clue.text: One rook in a tree

parts.note: an ace is the one in cards or dice
R is the chess abbreviation for rook

explanation.surface: A single rook is perched in a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Acer is the genus of maples, so a type of tree.

clue.text: Choice testimonial given to Penny

parts.note: a reference is a testimonial written by a former employer

explanation.surface: A selected letter of recommendation is handed to a woman named Penny.
explanation.definitionFit: A preference is the option one favours.

clue.text: In disagreement about blasphemous language

parts.note: on means about, as in a talk on a subject
swear words could be called bad terms

explanation.surface: A quarrel arises over profane swearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom for people who are not friendly with each other.

clue.text: Where one sultan contrived to hold bishop?

indicators.note: to hold is to contain, so the bishop letter sits within the shuffled letters

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: contrived means artificially arranged, so these letters are reworked

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: Asks where a single sultan schemed to keep a bishop captive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contrived' rearranges I and SULTAN into ISTANUL, and 'to hold' puts B inside, before the final UL.
explanation.definitionFit: The city on the Bosphorus was the seat of the Ottoman sultans, so it answers this 'where'.

clue.text: High priest's triumphant cry to a Hebrew prophet

parts.note: Eli was the high priest who raised Samuel; with the possessive he gives Eli's
ha is a cry of triumph

explanation.surface: A high priest calls out victoriously to an Old Testament prophet.
explanation.definitionFit: Elijah's successor was an Old Testament prophet of Israel.

clue.text: Drinking-party provides many with stimulation

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, hence many
arousal is excitement or stimulation

explanation.surface: A boozy party offers lots of people excitement.
explanation.definitionFit: A carousal is a riotous drinking bout.

clue.text: European needs information about Sandhurst

indicators.note: about means around, so the information-word wraps the academy letters

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
RMA is the Royal Military Academy at Sandhurst, Britain's officer college

explanation.surface: A continental needs facts on the army officer school.
explanation.definitionFit: A national of Germany is a European.

clue.text: Reprimand means one has to make the case again

explanation.surface: A rebuke suggests a lawyer must argue the case once more.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense splits the word as re-prove: to prove again.
explanation.definitionFit: To reprove is to scold; re-prove means to demonstrate once more.

clue.text: Permit father and son to have fun

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
sport means fun or amusement

explanation.surface: A request to let Dad and his boy enjoy themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: A passport is an official document authorising travel, so a kind of permit.

clue.text: He's against giving work to a model

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
a poser is someone who models or poses

explanation.surface: Someone objects to handing a job to a model.
explanation.definitionFit: An opponent is one who stands against something.

clue.text: Stock must be put through a sieve

explanation.surface: Cooking advice: soup stock must be sieved.
explanation.definitionFit: A strain is a breed or lineage; to strain liquid is to filter it.

clue.text: About to appeal-yet again!

definitions.note: an adverbial phrase defining a noun meaning a recurrence

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a petition is a formal appeal

explanation.surface: An exasperated cry at another plea about to be lodged.
explanation.definitionFit: A repetition is something done once more, an echo of what came before.

clue.text: Circular enclosure accessible to all

parts.note: O is round, so it stands for circular
a pen is an enclosure for animals

explanation.surface: A round compound that anyone may enter.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unrestricted is available to everyone.

clue.text: To make icy roads safe calls for courage

explanation.surface: Gritting winter roads needs bravery.
explanation.definitionFit: Grit is spread on frozen roads; it also means determination or pluck.

clue.text: In Jericho I recorded a lot of singers

indicators.note: in says the letters lie inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A recording of a group of singers made in the biblical city.
explanation.definitionFit: A choir is a body of singers, as in a church.

clue.text: Hard to fathom why corruption engulfed good man and king

indicators.note: engulfed means swallowed up, so the corruption-word surrounds the other letters

parts.note: abuse is corruption or misuse
ST, saint, is a good man
R, rex, is the abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about why vice overwhelmed a virtuous man and a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Something obscure or recondite is difficult to understand.

clue.text: It enables one to hear new releases pronto

indicators.note: new tells us these letters are given a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A device that lets you listen to the latest record releases at once.
explanation.definitionFit: A Walkman-style portable cassette or CD player with headphones lets one listen to music.
